sodium.neoForgeBuildOnly: Sodium's Fabric build would mesh NeoForge's models, fluids and lighting the way Fabric has them, and drop the geometry NeoForge mods add to chunks; Sodium for NeoForge draws them, and Fabric block models through its own Fabric renderer

notWithNeoForge.iris: Iris for NeoForge hooks classes of Sodium for NeoForge (its fluid renderer) that Sodium's Fabric build doesn't have

iris.neoForgeBuildOnly: Iris's Fabric build needs Sodium's Fabric build and leaves out NeoForge's render pipelines

notWithNeoForge.sodium: Iris's Fabric build hooks classes of Sodium's Fabric build (its fluid renderer) that Sodium for NeoForge doesn't have
